question: Which of the following Indian states shares a boundary with both Bangladesh and Myanmar?
solution:
The correct answer is** Mizoram.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mizoram** is a state in Northeast India, **bordered by Bangladesh to the west** and **Myanmar to the east and south.**
 
• **Assam** shares a **boundary with Bangladesh.** It is also a state in Northeast India, known for its tea plantations and wildlife sanctuaries.
 
• **Manipur **shares a **boundary with Myanmar**. It is also a state in Northeast India, known for its scenic beauty and cultural heritage.
 
• **Nagaland** shares a **boundary with Myanmar**. It is also a state in Northeast India, known for its tribal culture and festivals.
